The amendments to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 19891 made in the year 2016, brought in their wake an alteration in the practice and procedure for hearing of bail applications. This has created inconsistencies in the procedure for hearing of bail applications/bail appeals, uncertainty in the period of maturation of bail applications/bail appeals, and deferment of hearing of bail applications/bail appeals under the Act for undefined periods.
